Subject: Post-call: Context bandwidth & token mix — next steps and target $/1M

Hi Tom / Emma — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and the asks we committed to: 

- Use case summary: multi-turn product assistant + document retrieval for onboarding flows. Typical session: user question -> retrieval of 2–6 docs -> 1–2 assistant clarifying prompts -> final completion.
- Current hypothesis on token mix (please confirm with samples): avg prompt tokens ~ 1.2k, avg completion tokens ~ 600. 10% of sessions require long context (>=32k), ~2% require 128k for full-article chains.
- Volume: you mentioned 20–40M monthly prompts (sessions), with spike patterns around releases.

Actions we agreed: 
1) You to share ~200 sample interactions (anonymized) or a small context sample file (JSONL).
2) We (Neha + Vivek) will produce a short cost sensitivity model for 8k / 32k / 128k context tiers and show target $/1M tokens to hit your budget band.
3) Follow-up call next week to review numbers and propose Dedicated vs Hosted mix.

Attached: redwood_pricing_cheatsheet.pdf (high-level unit rates) and a sample context schema. I flagged the items we need in the sample.

Thanks — Karthik

--

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifications from our side: 

- We can extract ~250 anonymized interactions by Friday; will try to include the longer threads that hit 32k and a couple that needed the full 128k pull.
- Monthly active sessions look like 28M right now; peak month could reach 45M. Avg tokens you quoted look in-line, but our completions vary: 30% short (<=200 tokens), 60% mid (200–800), 10% long (800–2,500).
- Important: target spend band is $18k–$30k per month initially (pilot), with upside to $80k/mo in year 1 if quality holds.

We can also share a small set of retrieval docs (100 PDF pages) to help illustrate how often we need the 32k/128k windows.

—Tom

Subject: Cost sensitivity sketch (internal)

Summary of profiler (based on Tom's mix and our latency/price assumptions):
- Assumptions: hosted unit rates (example): $700 / 1M tokens for 8k context profile, $920 / 1M tokens for 32k profile, $1,350 / 1M tokens for 128k profile. (These are illustrative — exact pricing to confirm).
- Mix input: 28M sessions/mo -> average tokens per session = prompt 1.2k + completion 600 = 1.8k tokens/session -> total ~50.4B tokens/mo.

Scenarios:
A) Pilot (28M sessions) using primarily 8k path with 10% 32k, 2% 128k:
- Effective blended $/1M = (0.88*$700 + 0.10*$920 + 0.02*$1350) = $734.6 / 1M tokens.
- Monthly spend ~ 50.4B tokens / 1M * $734.6 = $37,033 (above their pilot target $18k–$30k).

B) Cost-optimized mix with caching & prompt reduction (15% token reduction overall):
- Total tokens -> 42.84B; blended $/1M roughly $720 -> monthly spend ~$30,850 (in their pilot band with engineering optimizations).

C) Dedicated reserved capacity (negotiated) — hypothetical unit $/1M = $620 flat (volume commit):
- 50.4B -> monthly spend ~$31,248 (fits pilot upper bound after commit discount).

Key levers to hit pilot target: prompt size reduction (template + retrieval pruning), prefix caching for repeated material, and routing heavier-session users to Dedicated pools.

Attached: context_sample.jsonl (distribution), quick spreadsheet link (Drive).

-Neha

Tom / Emma — thanks for the fast turnaround. Next steps proposed below (short, actionable):

1) You send the 250 anonymized interactions + sample retrieval docs (timeline: EOD Friday). We'll validate token counts and flag outliers.
2) We will run the profiler and share a 2-page cost summary: (a) blended $/1M at current mix, (b) optimized $/1M with 15% token reduction, (c) Dedicated pricing scenario with commitment thresholds. Deliverable: Monday EOB.
3) Pilot proposal: 3-month pilot with a 5–10% reserved commitment for Dedicated (if you want unit economics stability). We will include an early-exit SLA for quality regressions.

Quick plain-English unit economics takeaways (from Neha's draft):
- If your true average session is ~1.8k tokens and monthly sessions are 28M, expect ~50B tokens/mo. At current hosted mixes that maps to $~37k/mo.
- With a focused caching & prompt reduction effort (engineering work), we can plausibly reach ~$31k/mo or lower; Dedicated commits can push that further to ~$25–30k/mo depending on term.

Please confirm you can share samples and we’ll lock the Monday deliverable. Also confirm whether your procurement needs a vendor security questionnaire at pilot stage; we can expedite SOC2 artifacts if needed.

Cheers — Karthik
